title.zh: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Hold Protocol IP for the DAO
title.en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Hold Protocol IP for the DAO

current_state.zh: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
